## Escalation Routing

Escalated conversations are assigned to the Chatwoot "Support" Team (id 1, members: Lee Test, Bernice), not a single hardcoded agent. Chatwoot's own auto-assignment then routes to whichever team member is online.

To add/remove agents from escalation routing, edit the Support team's membership directly in Chatwoot (Settings > Teams), not this workflow. To route to a different team, change the `team_id` value in the "Assign Conversation to Support Team" node's JSON body.

nodes.content:
## Multichannel AI Assistant for Chatwoot — RAG Edition

This replaces the demo's built-in LangChain LLM node with a call to the deployed FastAPI RAG pipeline (`http://irrihub-fastapi:8000/chat`), which:

* Detects language (en/sw)
* Retrieves grounded context from the pgvector knowledge base
* Generates a response via OpenRouter using that context
* Returns a `route` field (`respond` / `escalate` / `deterministic`)

On `route == "escalate"`, the workflow now: sends the AI's handoff reply, labels the conversation `needs-human`, AND assigns it to a real Chatwoot agent (see "Escalation Assignee Config" node) so someone actually gets notified — not just a label sitting unattended.

The FastAPI side also tracks escalated conversations in its own `sessions` table (`is_human_managed`), so if /chat is ever called on an escalated conversation it won't answer the question. But the workflow now goes a step further: right after confirming the message is incoming, it calls Chatwoot directly ("Get Conversation State") and checks `meta.assignee` (the GET /conversations/{id} response nests assignment under `meta.assignee`, NOT a top-level `assignee_id` field). If the conversation is already assigned to anyone (bot-escalated or manually assigned by staff), the workflow stops immediately and posts NOTHING back — no canned "a team member is already helping" spam on every message once a human has taken over.

### Setup notes
1. Reuses the same Chatwoot `api_access_token` as the original demo workflow (hardcoded in the HTTP nodes, matching prior practice). Consider migrating to an n8n credential later for better secret hygiene.
2. Confirm `irrihub-fastapi` and `irrihub-n8n` remain on the shared `irrihub-net` Docker network (already true today).
3. Update the "Escalation Assignee Config" node's assigneeId if the Chatwoot agent roster changes.
